responsibility: Contains the M32R machine description that defines the target’s RTL instruction set, attributes, and scheduler model. It specifies instruction types, lengths, CPU and pipeline attributes, automaton-based reservation rules for M32R/M32R2/M32Rx issue behavior, concrete define_insn and define_expand patterns for arithmetic, moves, calls, PIC sequences, block moves, cache-flush operations, and split patterns, thereby driving instruction selection, recognition, shortening, and scheduling for generated M32R assembly.
same_name_distinction: RTL machine-description file for M32R: unlike m32r.cc and m32r.h it expresses the target primarily through define_insn/define_expand patterns, attributes, and automaton reservations used by instruction selection and scheduling, and unlike m32r.opt it does not declare user-facing switches but instead describes the generated instructions and pipeline behavior those switches may influence.
